observations: Truck-mounted borehole drilling rig with an orange mast and white cab.
Nissan Diesel 'UD' emblem on the front grille and 'NISSAN DIESEL' text above it.
Stylized 'PR' logo on the side of the mast.
Hydraulic cylinders, hoses, and a rotary head are visible on the mast.
Auxiliary engine and compressor unit mounted on the truck chassis behind the cab.
Front bumper has a sign: 'RIGHT HAND STEERING NO HAND SIGNAL'.
Plateau State license plate XA 385 MKK is visible on the front bumper.
The truck has a 6x4 wheel configuration (ten wheels total).

claims.evidence: Requires video evidence of the truck and rig in operation.
Requires verification of all mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.

risks.proof: Video of the truck starting and driving through all gears.
Video of the mast being raised and the leveling jacks extending.

risks.risk: Drill head or rotary motor failure
risks.proof: Video of the rotary head spinning and moving along the mast.
Video of the auxiliary unit running and building air pressure.
Photos of the pipe rack and all included drilling tools/bits.
risks.if_unproven: as machine only, without drill string

proof_requests: Video of the truck engine starting and the vehicle driving.
Video of the drilling rig mast being raised and the drill head rotating.
Video of the auxiliary compressor engine running.
Clear photos of the drilling control panel and gauges.
Inventory of included drill pipes and bits.
response.reason: The provided comparable is for a 'Drilling Machine' at a price point that suggests a hand tool or small manual unit, which is not comparable to a truck-mounted industrial rig.
